Diego (EM): Heads up, hiring blitz for EU office next month — three mid-month start dates overlapping our June blackout. Question: do we prorate accruals or allow one-time carryover for launch coverage?
Emma (People Ops): Standard is prorated accruals. We can approve one-time carryover for launch-critical roles with manager sign-off and a submitted exception form.
Nina (Recruiter): Two contractors convert to full-time on 2027-06-11 and 2027-06-15. Will those be treated as new hires?
Emma (People Ops): Yes, treat conversion effective date as start date for accruals.
Sam (Payroll): Payroll note: we need Workday start dates and employee IDs to compute proration. Allow 48 hours after submission for adjustments.
Diego (EM): I'll gather names and file the request by EOD. Thanks!
